selection_rules.reviewed_validation: all 47 unique validation images from the completed 70-component manual audit
selection_rules.empty_fire_hotspot: 30 train Fire images with empty pseudo Fire core, selected by farthest-point timestamp dispersion with thermal score as tie-break
selection_rules.suspected_label_gap_hot_noncore: 15 train Fire images ranked by 80C-plus non-core thermal extent, ignore extent and component count, with 12-second within-block spacing
selection_rules.small_or_weak_fire_core: 25 train Fire images ranked by small core, lower peak temperature and boundary-to-core ratio, with 12-second within-block spacing
selection_rules.boundary_complex_fire_core: 20 train Fire images ranked by ignored-boundary/core ratio and component count, with 12-second within-block spacing
selection_rules.no_fire_hotspot_negative: 13 train No-Fire images ranked by strongest thermal response with spatial-cluster diversity

annotation_policy.purpose: resolve active-fire versus residual-heat and smoke-occlusion ambiguity before any data-side training change
